title: Public Speeches and Writings by Senior Officials
what_it_is: Public Speeches and Writings by Senior Officials

sections.label: Duties of non-resident envoys
sections.summary: Non-Resident Ambassadors, Ambassadors-at-Large, Special Envoys and Honorary Consuls General must advance Singapore's interests and uphold its reputation, though not civil servants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: All these individuals, that means, the Non-Resident Ambassadors, Ambassadors-at-Large, Special Envoys or Honorary Consuls General are all expected to discharge their duties of safeguarding and advancing Singapore's national interests, explaining and defending Singapore's policies, as well as upholding the integrity and reputation of Singapore at all times.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Non-Resident Ambassadors, Ambassadors-at-Large and Special Envoys are not civil servants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Beyond their specific Ministry of Foreign Affairs commitments and role, we do not restrict their private engagements and this includes giving speeches or contributing articles in their personal capacities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, all of them are expected to exercise good judgement and to do their best to uphold and promote Singapore's national interests and I believe all of them do so in good faith, honourably and diligently.

sections.label: Bilahari Kausikan's personal comments
sections.summary: Bilahari Kausikan is not ambassador to any specific country and his speeches are not cleared by or representing the Singapore Government.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: I was referring to Ambassador-at-Large Mr Bilahari Kausikan and his comments on Malaysian politics, which I believe were made in October last year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: He is not our ambassador to Malaysia or to any other specific country.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: And as I have explained just now, his speeches, his essays are not cleared by me, they do not reflect or represent nor does he even attempt to say that they are the positions of the Singapore Government.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: He is free to speak and to comment, in the same way you are free to speak and comment as a private citizen.

sections.label: Diplomacy through proper channels
sections.summary: Government-designated ambassadors conduct diplomacy with respective countries, and messages and negotiations go through proper channels.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: As far as Government policy is concerned, we have designated ambassadors to conduct diplomacy with the respective countries that we need to engage and if there are any messages that need to be transmitted or any negotiations that need to be conducted, they will be done through proper channels.
